name: Allow cards
why: How a thread gets a folder on your computer, and how fast you answer in its thread
ideal: One Allow once card per Mac thread, a worktree for a shared folder, and an answer inside the thread within minutes.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

steps.name: Card
steps.rule: Turn on Worktree on the card when another thread works in the same folder.

steps.name: Answer
steps.rule: Answer a card or prompt in its own thread: a go-ahead in the project conversation does not reach it.

steps.name: Run
steps.rule: The thread runs in auto mode when that computer's Claude Code allows it, so it raises one Allow once card.
